```artifact
Feature: Maintain Doctors and Chemists/Labs
  As an administrator,
  I want to manage doctors and chemists/labs,
  So that I can ensure accurate and up-to-date information.

  Scenario: Adding a new doctor
    Given I am on the Add Doctor Screen
    When I enter the required details
    And I submit the form
    Then a new Doctor Id is generated
    And the doctor details are saved successfully

  Scenario: Editing an existing doctor
    Given I am on the Edit/Update Doctors Screen
    And I query for an existing Doctor Id
    Then the original doctor details are displayed
    When I modify the doctor details
    And I submit the form
    Then the doctor details are updated successfully

  Scenario: Deleting a doctor with no open consultation requests
    Given I am on the Edit/Update Doctors Screen
    And I query for a Doctor Id with no open consultation requests
    When I delete the doctor
    Then the doctor details are deleted successfully

  Scenario: Deleting a doctor with open consultation requests
    Given I am on the Edit/Update Doctors Screen
    And I query for a Doctor Id with open consultation requests
    When I attempt to delete the doctor
    Then an exception error message is displayed "Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete"

  Scenario: Attempting to edit a non-existent doctor
    Given I am on the Edit/Update Doctors Screen
    When I query for a non-existent Doctor Id
    Then an exception error message is displayed "Doctor does not exist"

  Scenario: Adding a new chemist/lab
    Given I am on the Add Chemist/Lab Screen
    When I enter the required details
    And I submit the form
    Then a new Chemist/Lab Id is generated
    And the chemist/lab details are saved successfully

  Scenario: Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Doctors
    Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
    When I navigate to the Maintain Doctors section
    Then I see options to Add Doctors and Edit/Update Doctors

  Scenario: Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Chemist & Labs
    Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
    When I navigate to the Maintain Chemist & Labs section
    Then I see options to Add Chemist/Labs and Edit/Update Chemist/Labs

  Scenario Outline: Adding a doctor with invalid input values
    Given I am on the Add Doctor Screen
    When I enter invalid <field> value "<value>"
    And I submit the form
    Then an error message is displayed "<message>"

    Examples:
      | field      | value | message                           |
      | Doctor Name|       | Doctor Name is required           |
      | Age        | -1    | Age must be a positive number     |
      | Age        | 150   | Age must be less than 150         |
      | Experience | -1    | Experience must be a positive number |
      | Experience | 100   | Experience must be less than 100  |

  Scenario Outline: Editing a doctor with invalid input values
    Given I am on the Edit/Update Doctors Screen
    And I query for an existing Doctor Id
    When I enter invalid <field> value "<value>"
    And I submit the form
    Then an error message is displayed "<message>"

    Examples:
      | field      | value | message                           |
      | Doctor Name|       | Doctor Name is required           |
      | Age        | -1    | Age must be a positive number     |
      | Age        | 150   | Age must be less than 150         |
      | Experience | -1    | Experience must be a positive number |
      | Experience | 100   | Experience must be less than 100  |

  Scenario Outline: Adding a chemist/lab with invalid input values
    Given I am on the Add Chemist/Lab Screen
    When I enter invalid <field> value "<value>"
    And I submit the form
    Then an error message is displayed "<message>"

    Examples:
      | field              | value | message                           |
      | Chemist Lab Name   |       | Chemist Lab Name is required      |
      | Chemist Lab Address|       | Chemist Lab Address is required   |
      | Chemist Lab Contact|       | Chemist Lab Contact is required   |
```
